name: SVF QA CI Guard
description: Run qa:ci on weekday schedule; spawn fix agent on failure

actions.prompt: Run npm run qa:ci in the SlabVault/SVF repo. If it fails, diagnose and apply the smallest correct fix. Run qa:ci again to verify. Update docs/STATUS.md with results. Do not commit or push unless ORCHESTRATE_ALLOW_COMMIT=1 is set in the automation environment. Do not merge PRs.
